title: Shadowblade Valoria
game_overview: A nostalgic 16-bit side-scrolling stealth-action platformer where assassin Kael infiltrates the sunlit rooftops of Valoria to eliminate a corrupt captain.
winning_condition: Defeat the corrupt Guard Captain in the fortified district and escape through the Eastern Gate.
losing_condition: Player health reaches zero from enemy strikes or falling into deadly drop zones.

controls.input: A / D or Left / Right Arrow Keys
controls.action: Move left and right across rooftops and platforms.

controls.input: W or Up Arrow Key / Spacebar
controls.action: Jump across gaps, grab ledges, pull up, or climb ladders and vertical surfaces.
Crouch behind environmental cover, sneak, or drop down through semitransparent ledges.
Perform standard sword strike and 3-hit melee sword combination.
Raise defensive sword block to deflect incoming attacks, or dodge roll while moving.
Execute contextual stealth assassination from behind or aerial takedown from above.
Pause the game, view mission objectives, or toggle audio settings.
Comprehensive on-screen touch controls for fluid mobile traversal and combat.

sections.title: Design Pillars
sections.content: 1. Nostalgic Java Action Heritage: Capture the vibrant golden-hour medieval atmosphere, responsive acrobatics, and tactical pacing reminiscent of classic 2007-2012 mobile platformers. 2. Fluid Kinetic Traversal: Movement feels crisp, organic, and predictable with ledge grabs, wall-climbs, and smooth parkour flow. 3. Rewarding Stealth & Combat Synergy: Players can choose silent ghost assassinations or fluid swordplay with parries, combos, and dodges.
sections.summary: Core emotional and mechanical tenets governing gameplay feel and presentation.

sections.title: Core Loop
sections.content: Traverse the Valoria rooftops using parkour -> Observe guard patrol sightlines -> Execute stealth assassinations or engage in sword combat -> Collect hidden royal relics and potions -> Infiltrate the castle interior and defeat the Guard Captain -> Reach the Eastern Gate to complete the mission.
sections.summary: The moment-to-moment gameplay cycle from rooftop infiltration to escape.

sections.title: Movement & Scrolling Alignment
sections.content: Scrolling Axis: Horizontal (Left-to-Right progression with vertical platforming layers). Asset Orientation: All humanoid sprites face right (3 o'clock) by default and flip horizontally (scaleX = -1) when moving left. Kinetics: Responsive gravity-based 2D platforming with solid acceleration, ledge detection for automatic mantle grabbing, ladder climbing mechanics, wall-slide/wall-jump arcs, and ground dodge roll. Camera: Smooth horizontal tracking with forward-looking deadzone that shifts ahead during sprints to telegraph rooftop gaps and enemy patrol cones.
sections.summary: Horizontal side-scrolling physics model, parkour kinetics, and camera tracking.

sections.title: Stealth & Sensory AI System
sections.content: Enemies feature dual-layer sensory cones (Focal Vision: narrow long-range instant alert, Peripheral Vision: wide medium-range progressive awareness meter). Guards follow an explicit 4-stage Finite State Machine: 1. Unaware (regular patrol route with casual waypoint pauses), 2. Suspicious (question mark indicator above head, investigating noise or glimpse), 3. Searching (active patrol looking for disturbance), 4. Alert/Combat (exclamation indicator, drawing blade and chasing player). Sneaking behind an unaware guard or dropping from above prompts an instant contextual Stealth Assassination (E key) eliminating the guard instantly with a cinematic slice.
sections.summary: Guard sensory cones, 4-stage alert state machine, and silent takedown rules.

sections.title: Combat & Defense System
sections.content: Player starts with 5 Health Points. Standard guards have 3 HP, while the Captain possesses 8 HP with armored hyper-armor phases. Light Attack (J) performs a 3-hit slash chain with hit-stop impact frames. Guard/Block (K) reduces damage by 80% and parries attacks when timed before impact, staggering the opponent. Dodge Roll grants brief invulnerability frames (i-frames) to bypass guard cleaves. Defeated guards drop score orbs and occasional health potions.
sections.summary: Responsive real-time melee sword combat mechanics and boss encounter rules.

sections.title: Level 1: The Rooftops of Valoria
sections.content: The level begins atop Kael's vantage tower overlooking the golden sunset of Valoria. Section 1 (Tutorial Rooftops): Master running, jumping across chimneys, ledge mantling, and crouch cover. Section 2 (Alley Bridges & Climbing): Climb ivy-covered brick walls, navigate narrow wooden bridges, and execute a stealth takedown on an isolated sentry. Section 3 (Castle District Courtyard): Face paired guard patrols with options for shadow evasion or open swordfight. Section 4 (Captain's Keep & Boss Battle): Duel Guard Captain Malakor featuring sweeping heavy slashes and shield bash maneuvers. Section 5 (Eastern Gate Escape): Sprint past falling portcullis gates into the sunset to trigger victory.
sections.summary: Pacing, landmark layout, encounters, and progression structure of the introductory mission.

sections.title: Visual Hierarchy & Layering
sections.content: Background Layer: 3-layer parallax with warm golden sunset sky, distant castle spires, and silhouette rooftops with desaturated tones. Playfield Layer: High-contrast sandstone blocks, terracotta roof tiles, wooden beams, lanterns, animated torches, and crisp 16-bit character sprites with distinct outlines. Foreground Layer: Subtle dust particles, flying birds, and silhouette roof gables. HUD Overlay: Diegetic medieval scroll frames displaying Kael's health gems, objective compass, stealth eye status icon, and score tally positioned safely in screen corners.
sections.summary: Strict visual separation between parallax backgrounds, playfield, and HUD overlay.

sections.title: Characters & Enemies
sections.content: Protagonist (Kael): Agile assassin clad in charcoal hooded tunic, deep crimson scarf and sash, carrying a curved silver blade. Regular Guard (Valorian Sentry): Armored bipedal soldier equipped with iron helm, broadsword, and red tabard. Elite Boss (Captain Malakor): Heavy-armored commander wielding a gilded broadsword with high poise and telegraphed charge strikes.
sections.summary: Protagonist attributes, regular guards, and elite boss specifications.

sections.title: Fairness Tools & Checkpoints
sections.content: Checkpoints automatically save player progress at safe rooftop bonfires with health replenishment. Overhead sensory gauges show guard awareness accumulation before full alarm. Attack windup flashes (white/red glints) telegraph guard swings to enable reliable parries and dodges.
sections.summary: Visual telegraphs, checkpoint respawns, and sensory indicators for player clarity.

sections.title: Juice & Game Feel
sections.content: Anticipation Juice: Character squashes slightly before leaps, blade trails glow during sword combo strikes. State Change Juice: Crimson cloth ribbons flutter in wind, dust puffs on rooftop landings and rolls. Impact Juice: 3-frame hit stop on successful sword strikes, subtle camera shake on heavy strikes, and dynamic spark bursts on blade collisions.
sections.summary: Impact feedback, kinetic anticipation, particle systems, and audio layering.

sections.title: Structural Integrity
sections.content: Title Screen (New Game, How to Play, Audio Mute Toggle, High Scores) -> Intro Cinematic Card -> Interactive Gameplay -> Pause Menu -> Mission Complete / Game Over Screens with instant restart buttons and performance star ratings.
sections.summary: Screen flow, persistent high scores, settings, and mission clear sequences.

sections.title: Virtual Touch Controls Implementation
sections.content: Render on-screen virtual controls only when mobile is active using useIsMobile(). Left side: Floating D-Pad / Horizontal Left-Right arrows with touch-none class. Right side: Distinct Action Buttons (Jump, Attack, Block, Stealth Takedown). Wire up onPointerDown, onPointerUp, onPointerLeave, and onPointerCancel to prevent stuck inputs. Ensure high z-index and pointer-events-auto on action buttons only.
sections.summary: Mandatory mobile touchscreen overlay layout and pointer event handlers.
